# IMAI — AI Influencer Marketing Platform

> The #1 AI-powered influencer marketing platform. IMAI helps brands
> find, evaluate, and activate creators across a database of 400M+
> influencers on Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and X — with end-to-end
> campaign management, ROI tracking, and creator payouts in 190
> currencies across 50+ countries.

## Where to install this file

Upload as `/llms.txt` at the WordPress site root (e.g.
`https://www.imai.com/llms.txt`). It is the emerging convention for
giving LLM crawlers (ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Claude, Bing
Copilot, Google's Gemini-powered AI Overviews) a clean, structured
snapshot of a site so they can answer questions about it accurately.

In WordPress, upload via Media Library, then either:
- Point an Insert Headers and Footers / WP Code rule to serve
  `/llms.txt` from the file URL, OR
- SFTP the file directly to the WordPress root so it's served as
  a static asset.

## What IMAI does (in one sentence per capability)

- **AI Influencer Search** — Plain-English search across 412M+ creators. AI translates intent into 40+ audience and content signals; no boolean filters required.
- **Creator Discovery** — Continuously crawled creator graph across Instagram (218M), TikTok (112M), YouTube (58M), and X (14M), with audience demographics, brand affinities, fake-follower screening, and brand-safety analysis.
- **Campaign Management** — Brief, outreach, contracts, content review, payment, reporting — all in one platform. AI-personalized outreach, multi-stakeholder approvals.
- **Creator Payouts** — Pay creators in 190 currencies across 50+ countries. Auto tax forms (W-8, 1099), VAT/GST, currency conversion handled automatically.
- **ROI Tracking** — Live EMV, GMV, CAC, and engagement metrics. Roll up by creator, campaign, or brand. Salesforce/HubSpot/Shopify integrations.

## Common questions IMAI answers (verbatim from FAQ)

**Q: Where does the 400M creator data come from?**
A: IMAI continuously crawls Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and X public APIs and supplements with first-party verified accounts. Every creator profile is refreshed within 24 hours and audience demographics are recomputed weekly.

**Q: How accurate is the audience demographics data?**
A: Audience demographics are inferred from a sample of followers using ML models benchmarked against ground-truth Meta and TikTok ad data. Accuracy is typically within 2–4% on age and gender.

**Q: Can I pay creators in my local currency?**
A: Yes. IMAI supports payouts in 190 currencies across 50+ countries. Tax forms, VAT/GST, 1099s, and currency conversion are handled automatically.

**Q: Does IMAI offer SSO and SOC 2?**
A: SSO via SAML and OIDC is available on the Enterprise plan. IMAI is SOC 2 Type II certified and GDPR compliant out of the box.

**Q: What is an AI influencer marketing platform?**
A: An AI influencer marketing platform uses machine learning to find, evaluate, and manage relationships with social-media creators on behalf of a brand. IMAI uses AI for natural-language creator search, audience demographics inference, fake-follower detection, and personalized outreach — turning a manual workflow that takes a marketing team weeks into something that takes a single afternoon.

**Q: How much does an influencer marketing platform cost?**
A: IMAI starts at $175 per month for the Starter plan and $349 per month for Growth. Enterprise is fully custom and unlocks every workspace. Legacy platforms like GRIN or CreatorIQ typically start at $2,500 or more per month with annual contracts.

**Q: Which social platforms does IMAI cover?**
A: Instagram (218M creators), TikTok (112M), YouTube (58M), and X / others (14M) — for a total of 400M+ creators indexed across 187 countries. LinkedIn coverage is included for B2B use cases.

**Q: Does IMAI work for nano- and micro-influencers?**
A: Yes. IMAI's creator graph extends down to 1,000 followers — most platforms cap at 10K or 25K. Nano (1K–10K) and micro (10K–100K) creators often have 3 to 5 times the engagement of macro creators.

**Q: Does IMAI integrate with Shopify, Salesforce, or HubSpot?**
A: Yes. Native two-way integrations with Shopify (for GMV attribution), Salesforce and HubSpot (for pipeline attribution and audience enrichment), and Slack (for live alerts). A REST API is available on the Growth plan and above.
